title: Inside a turtle shell

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The exposed lines in this schematic represent ribs integrated with the shell. A turtle shell is connected to the skeleton; it is not a detachable shelter. The figure omits many bones and is not a scale dissection.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: A turtle’s shell is part of its skeleton. Which bones are integrated with the upper shell?

claims.text: Look beneath the shell surface. A turtle’s shell is part of its skeleton. Which bones are integrated with the upper shell? The figure omits many bones and is not a scale dissection.
